idea-plugin.name: Glance Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Colourful file and folder icons that make the project tree easier to scan.

  • One icon per Angular type: components, services, directives, pipes, guards, interceptors, routes, modules, stores and models, found by file name or by the decorator inside the file, including Angular 22's @Service() and files named after the 2025 style guide (user-card.ts).
  • Official logos for 30+ languages, frameworks and tools: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Python, Java, Kotlin, Rust, the Go gopher, Docker and more.
  • Config files in their tool's style: angular.json, tsconfig, ESLint, Prettier, Vite, Vitest, Jest, Tailwind, Storybook, Nx, npm, Yarn, pnpm and more.
  • Test badges for Java and Kotlin test classes, and a separate icon for every image format.
  • Folders: app, src, core, frontend, backend, components, services, directives, pipes, guards, interceptors, store, models and more.
  • Works in light and dark themes and in every JetBrains IDE.

Source roots, content roots and excluded folders keep the IDE's own icons, so you don't lose that information.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1: no more deprecated-API warnings from the JetBrains Plugin Verifier. Icons and behaviour are unchanged.
